# Scientific return: a general stochastic bulk construction and a complete pinned boundary receiver

Same sole Sol researcher, new stage, 2026-11-02. The three completed Gaussian-memory stages, their frozen returns, the former Ultra's source and unrelated researchers' work were preserved. No other researcher, Ultra, goal, automation, paid resource, hardware operation or programme message was used.

**Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.** The work produced two author-derived mathematical operations and exact discriminators. They have no independent whole audit and are not a complete arbitrary-core recurrence mechanism or a demonstrated practical technology.

## Strongest broad construction

For a finite weakly reversible mass-action network in arbitrary dimension and with arbitrary linkage multiplicity, the new primal receiver constructs a nonnegative normlike V such that

    L V(x)<=-1

outside a class-dependent finite head wherever all coordinates satisfy x_i>=max(1,2D), D the largest source degree. The generator is the actual count generator. The construction uses the newly public finite affine-family lemma, exact finite-jump log-sum-exp bound, a uniform Hoffman near-active calculation, source-cut domination and a convergent dyadic scale sum. The earlier unnecessary logarithmic cutoff was removed; the fixed cutoff is acquired before any strip exponent. V has polynomial growth with graph-dependent, potentially enormous exponent.

Read `BULK_FIXED_WIDTH_UPGRADE.md` with the complete underlying derivation in `BULK_CONSTRUCTION.md` and the effective/representation boundary in `BULK_REPRESENTATION_COST.md`. The mathematical finite affine family is supplied by the read governing primary theorem. Its effective numerical extraction was NOT performed, and `softmin_checks.py` makes no such claim.

## Complete actual-time boundary operation

For one free substrate inventory n=b+j_s and a finite A-neutral controller, acquire the true killed phase hitting vector v(n) by finite rational inversion. Set h=1+epsilon v, with epsilon chosen to pay the marked-state return cost. Every inventory-changing exchange starts and ends at a marked state where h is identically one for every n. Therefore

    W=t^n h_s(n)

# Fixed-width bulk upgrade

Author-derived and unaudited. This strengthens the weaker logarithmic-bulk construction in `BULK_CONSTRUCTION.md`; that file is preserved as the initial derivation. The global function, exact finite-jump bound, source-cut proof, classwise plateau exclusion, normalization and scale gluing remain the same. The improvement is a sharper use of the acquired active-region distance.

## Theorem

Subject to the governing finite affine-family lemma cited and read in the preceding construction, every finite weakly reversible mass-action network with fixed positive rates admits, on each positive affine compatibility class, a nonnegative normlike function V on the count orthant with

    L V(x)<=-1

outside a class-dependent finite set wherever EVERY coordinate is at least K=max(1,2D), where D is the largest source degree. The assertion covers arbitrary dimension and arbitrary linkage multiplicity. It is a BULK statement, not general recurrence: the union of excluded strips x_i<K is infinite. No bound uniform across conserved enzyme pools or actual communication classes is silently supplied.

If the compatibility class has no point with all coordinates >=1, its bulk is empty. Otherwise choose a single such c as the representative in the affine construction. A count state in the bulk has all sources enabled, and actual falling factorials are uniformly comparable to monomials. No high-volume or continuum limit occurs.

## The strengthened near-active calculation

Write n=min x_i, N=max x_i, R>=2N, and retain affine labels active somewhere in [1,R]^d as before. Their slopes are nonpositive, and the uniform Hoffman constant B is acquired from fixed coefficient matrices. Let

    ell=L log(2+N),

where L is a finite constant chosen below. Call a label near-active when its affine gap is at most ell. It has an actual active point z in [1,R]^d with

    |z-x|_infinity<=B ell.

Both x and z have every coordinate at least one. Hence, even when some x_i are bounded, every coordinate ratio between them is between

    1/(1+B ell) and 1+B ell.

The original derivation unnecessarily demanded a factor-two ratio, which required n to grow logarithmically. A polylogarithmic distortion is enough. If r_i.u<r_i.v, the primary source sign-gap lemma at z gives

    z^v/z^u<=R^(-H),
    x^v/x^u<=(1+B ell)^(|v-u|_1) R^(-H)
              <=(1+B ell)^(2D) R^(-H).

# An actual-time receiver with a profile pinned at every inventory-changing interface

Author-derived construction, not independently audited and not a claimed solution of arbitrary weak reversibility. This is a concrete attempt to remove the neighboring-Green-profile obstruction in a compatible boundary model. It is kept as an operation toward the larger question, not promoted as completion of the civilisation-scale mission.

## 1. Raw model and conclusion

There are free counts A=a and B=b, and exactly one finite controller/enzyme in phases s in E. Each phase has a fixed nonnegative integer inventory j_s. Put

    n=b+j_s,     M=a+n.

The only count-changing reservoir is 0<->A, with immigration lambda>0 and death mu a, mu>0. Internal phase transitions s->r change B by j_s-j_r and preserve a and n. Their rates are acquired from a finite mass-action list, are independent of a, and depend polynomially on b with nonnegative falling-factorial forms and positive coefficients. Let Q_n be their actual finite phase generator at inventory n. Choose n0 so that, for n>=n0, every phase is available and the enabled directed phase graph is fixed. Every phase must reach a nonempty marked set G in that graph.

Only marked phases support A/B exchange, and every such exchange leaves its phase unchanged. At a marked phase the finite list consists of positive-rate reversible pairs

    A+kB+E_s <-> (k+1)B+E_s,     k>=0.                    (1)

Every marked phase has at least one pair. These have actual rates f_(s,k) a (b)_k and r_(s,k) (b)_(k+1). Parallel pairs are allowed. The phase graph may contain cycles and need not obey detailed balance. No stationary phase law is supplied.

All internal moves preserve M, so M(t)<=M(0)+Poisson(lambda t). This gives nonexplosion directly. The complete construction below proves a Foster inequality outside a finite set and, for each prescribed theta>0, finite invariant E exp(theta M) on every closed irreducible class. If the original raw network is weakly reversible, every actual communication class is closed by its translated complex return paths.

This statement is broader than the unit-rate bottleneck and does not need a spectral gap, but it still has real architectural restrictions: bounded controller phase, one free nonport inventory, A-neutral hidden motion, and pinned inventory-changing outputs. No theorem for arbitrary coupled bound
